title: 中国人的夏夜③冰粉：一碗透心凉，居然是用手"搓"出来的 | Summer Nights P3 · Iced Jelly 🥶
description:
你吃冰粉，加不加山楂？红糖还是牛奶？评论区选一个。

【中国人的夏夜 第3集 冰粉】夏夜街边最清凉的一碗冰粉，其实是用手"搓"出来的。它的原料，是一种树的种子——冰粉树，学名假酸浆（又叫珍珠莲）。把种子装进纱布，在清水里揉搓，慢慢搓出胶质，加一点凝固剂，冷藏一冻就成了晶莹的冻。这手艺明清就有，源自四川武阳（今彭山），清朝中期传遍四川。浇上红糖水，撒山楂、葡萄干、花生碎，街边的"冰粉孃孃"守着摊，一勺下去，透心凉。用四川话说：巴适得板。

Ep.3 Bingfen iced jelly. The coolest bowl on a summer street is literally hand-rubbed. It starts from a tree's seeds — the "bingfen tree," botanically Nicandra (apple-of-Peru). You wrap the seeds in cloth, rub them in clean water until a gel releases, add a touch of setting agent, and chill it into a crystal jelly. The craft dates to the Ming-Qing era in Sichuan's Wuyang (today's Pengshan). Drizzle brown-sugar syrup, scatter hawthorn, raisins and crushed peanuts; the street "bingfen aunties" tend their stalls, and one spoon goes cool to the core. As Sichuan people say: bashi de ban — just perfect.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
